title: Shillong Teer Results Today, October 2, 2025: Winning Numbers For All Teer Games | India News - News18
text: SHILLONG TEER RESULT TODAY, OCTOBER 2, 2025 LIVE UPDATES: The Shillong Teer lottery is a distinctive archery-based game conducted daily at the Polo Stadium in Shillong, Meghalaya. Managed by the Khasi Hills Archery Sports Association, the lottery offers appealing cash prizes while promoting archery among the region’s youth. ALSO READ: Happy Dussehra 2025: Top 50 Wishes, Images, Quotes And Status To Share With Your Loved Ones On Vijayadashami Below are the winning numbers for October 2, 2025, for all major Teer games, including Shillong Morning Teer, Juwai Teer, Khanapara Teer, Shillong Teer, Jowai Ladrymbai Teer and Night Teer. ALSO READ: Happy Gandhi Jayanti 2025: Heartfelt Wishes, Images, Motivational Quotes, Messages, And WhatsApp Status The Shillong Teer lottery combines the age-old sport of archery with the thrill of winning cash prizes. Popular throughout Meghalaya, it provides attractive rewards while also helping to preserve and promote this traditional sport. The Shillong Teer lottery is conducted in two quick rounds, each lasting approximately two minutes. In the first round, archers shoot 30 arrows, followed by 20 arrows in the second round. Participants place their bets by selecting a number between 0 and 99, predicting the total number of arrows that will hit the target. Tickets are available at licensed counters in denominations of Rs 1, Rs 5, Rs 10, Rs 20 and Rs 50. The prize amount depends on both the ticket value and the accuracy of the prediction. For instance, a Rs 1 ticket with a correct guess in the first round wins Rs 80, while a correct prediction in the second round earns Rs 60. Players who successfully predict both rounds can win up to Rs 4,000 with a Re 1 ticket. In addition to Shillong Teer, other popular Teer games include Juwai Teer, Khanapara Teer, Ladrymbai Teer, and Night Teer.
